hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$cmd" in *--amend*) exit 0;; esac; git worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree /{print substr($0,10)}' | xargs -I{} git -C {} status --porcelain -- log.md 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Docs not updated for this commit. Before committing: append a dated entry to log.md (append-only, never edit old entries); refresh the progress.md snapshot in place (current state, verified items, decisions, next candidates); update feature_list.md statuses and known limitations if features changed. Update README.md only if this commit makes it factually wrong. Stage the updated docs so they land in the same commit, then re-run git commit."}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that project docs are updated before commit

hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Feature workflow (project hook): if this prompt starts implementation of a new feature (new functionality - not a question, bug fix, doc/config tweak, or ops/deploy task), develop it in a dedicated git worktree: (1) before editing any file, create one - prefer the EnterWorktree tool if available, otherwise run: git worktree add ../db_delay_predictor-<slug> -b feature/<slug> ; (2) make every change inside that worktree only; (3) when the feature is complete, STOP and report - do NOT commit, push, or remove the worktree on your own; wait for the user to review and explicitly ask for the commit/push; (4) only after the user gives the go-ahead: commit in the worktree, push the branch to origin, merge the branch into main from the main checkout (stash any unrelated local changes around the merge), push main, and remove the worktree (ExitWorktree, or: git worktree remove ../db_delay_predictor-<slug>) - the pushed branch survives; (5) finally deploy so the change is live on delaybahn.com: ssh root@delaybahn_hetzner2 and, as user stripathi in /home/stripathi/Documents/code_local/db_delay_predictor, stash any uncommitted server-side edits, run git pull --no-rebase --no-edit https://github.com/sha2nkt/delay_bahn.git main, restore the stash, then systemctl restart delaybahn and verify with systemctl is-active delaybahn plus a curl of https://delaybahn.com/health. Frontend changes also need the ?v=N cache-buster in static/index.html bumped before the push, because Cloudflare edge-caches static assets. For prompts that are not new-feature work, ignore this note."}}'
